message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I have successfully retrieved the calendars for both Priya Raman and Marcus Hale. My next step is to identify the common 30-minute time slots during which they are both available. I will go through their schedules day by day for next week and compile a list of all possible meeting times.

After I have this list, I will need to communicate it to Brad. The shared workspace is the only way to do this. I'll write a clear message for Brad, listing all the potential slots, and ask him to check them against the calendars of Elena Soto and David Okafor. This will allow him to find a time that works for all four partners. Once I've posted the message, my part of the work is done for this session, so I will use `end_session`.
